result.ca_name_from_pdf: Google Trust Services LLC and Google Trust Services Europe Limited
result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – TLS Baseline Version 2.9

disclosed_matters.summary: GTS issued one certificate to a new team member without proper authorization workflow completion due to onboarding process gaps.
A bug in GTS' Google Trust self-auditing tool resulted in incorrect verification of Multi-Perspective Services Self-Issuance Corroboration perspectives used in domain control validation.
528,586 certificates lacked the desired number of remote perspective details for CAA checks due to issuance flow continuing without all MPCAA remote perspective CAA checks completing.
One certificate was issued without one of its certificate lifecycle events being recorded in the audit log due to a race condition in the authorization database.
